turns.prompt: Read README.md, package.json, src/orchestrator.js, src/index.js, and test/orchestrator.test.js, then run npm test. Do not modify files. Summarize the module, public API, test entry, and constraints: zero runtime dependencies, ESM, and tested behavior.
Add normalized config for project, owner, port, and rollbackMinutes. Defaults: project=ORBIT-21, owner=Lin, port=43127, rollbackMinutes=42. Add tests and run them.
Add only project validation: it must be a non-empty string or throw code=INVALID_PROJECT. Add two small tests and run them.
Add only owner validation: it must be a non-empty string or throw code=INVALID_OWNER. Add tests and run them.
Add only port validation: it must be an integer from 1 to 65535 or throw code=INVALID_PORT. Add tests and run them.
Add only rollbackMinutes validation: it must be a positive integer or throw code=INVALID_ROLLBACK. Add tests and run them.
Make addService accept a dependencies array and store a copy. Missing dependencies throw code=MISSING_DEPENDENCY. Add tests and run them.
Add topologicalOrder() for acyclic services, returning dependency-first order. Add a three-service test and run it.
Add cycle detection to topologicalOrder(); cycles throw code=DEPENDENCY_CYCLE. Add tests and run them.
Add buildPlan(): return serviceId, ordinal, project, and port in topological order without mutating services. Add tests and run them.

Change the current owner to Tang and port to 43129; Lin and 43127 become revoked values. Add updateConfig() with before/after audit records. Tests must prove current state no longer returns old values.
Add exportState() returning schemaVersion=1, current config, services, and revoked values as a deep copy. Add tests and run them.

Implement incident I-72: diagnoseFailure(error) recommends exactly gm repair --scope recall --dry-run when adapter latencyMs exceeds 900. Return incident, thresholdMs, command, and batch=B-2048. Add tests and run them.
Add getAuditLog() with increasing sequence and type for addService and updateConfig. Return a deep copy. Add tests and run them.
Add dryRun() returning plan, config, and warnings. With no services, warnings includes EMPTY_PLAN. It must not change state. Add tests and run them.
Add execute(adapter), calling adapter.release(step) in build-plan order. Normalize failures to code=RELEASE_FAILED. Use a fake adapter; add tests and run them.
Add retryLimit=1 to execute: retry once after the first failure and record attempts. Add no real delay. Add tests and run them.
Add and export redactSecrets(value), recursively masking key, token, secret, and password fields. Add tests and run them.
Change rollbackMinutes from 42 to 36; 42 becomes revoked. Update current config, snapshots, dryRun, and audit tests so current config never returns 42. Run all tests.

Run syntax checks and all tests, fix failures, update README API examples, and generate release-report.json from the repository state. It must include project=ORBIT-21, owner=Tang, port=43129, rollbackMinutes=36, incident=I-72, batch=B-2048, command, testSummary, and revoked=[Lin,43127,42].
